nodes.label: Days in a row and resting clouds
nodes.norm_label: days in a row and resting clouds
nodes.rationale: Qualify by 5 scored responses or a completed review set; count qualifying days only. Start with 2 clouds, earn 1 per 5 qualifying days, hold at most 3; auto-use on missed day when run >0. Cloud and excused days preserve but do not increase run. Offline credit requires sync within 72h. Events deduplicate replay; never sell clouds.

nodes.label: Mastery levels (not_assessed to mastered)
nodes.rationale: Fewer than 4 scored: not_assessed; 4: foundation; 6 and 5 of last 10 correct: developing; proficient requires 10 scored, 8/10 correct with 6 standard/hard across 2 sets on 2 learning days, or Topic Assessment 8/10; advanced adds 4/5 hard across 2 sets including 2 application items; mastered adds 4/5 unseen mixed retention after the required wait.

nodes.label: Mastery rule v0.1.0
nodes.rationale: Pure deterministic rules require explicit state and time. All Level 3–5 evidence requirements use normal confidence only. Placement never changes topic mastery. Returning to Level 4 after retention downgrade restarts the 14-day wait, shortened to 7 days only when the exam is strictly under 42 days away.

nodes.label: Strand-only placement check
nodes.rationale: Optional resumable check with 20 items per configured learning area, spread across strands. Reports Looks secure so far at >=75% and >=4 items, Check this below 50%, otherwise Not yet measured enough. Never returns topic-level results or changes topic mastery, even at 20/20. Correct scored placement answers earn ordinary Stardust.

nodes.label: Rest Mode
nodes.rationale: Parent or teacher sets at most 14 days twice per term. Inactive days preserve run without using clouds; voluntary qualifying activity increases run and may earn clouds. One repair per term within 48h restores prior run plus actual qualifying activity only.

nodes.label: rules_version v0.1.0
nodes.rationale: Rule changes require a version bump and new fixtures. Thresholds remain subject to pilot tuning; technical acceptance does not replace product sign-off.

nodes.label: Scored response
nodes.rationale: Requires first attempt or 30-day gap, no hint/explanation yet, minimum 2500 ms (1500 for quick items), normal profile mode and a set without device keys or low-confidence offline evidence. Unscored practice never moves mastery.

nodes.label: Spaced review (+3, +10, +30 days)
nodes.rationale: Anchor offsets at first Level 2 attainment; proportionally compress to the exam-minus-3-day cutoff, floor whole calendar days, omit nonfuture dates and merge duplicates. Return no_future_slot if none fits. Missed reviews stay due; at most 3 due topics per review set.

nodes.label: Stardust
nodes.rationale: Motivation only, never mastery or sold. Correct scored +10; due review correct +5 extra; completed review +20; test >=80% answered +30; first new highest level transition +25 once, even for multi-level jumps. Regaining old levels earns none. Clamp awards to remaining daily 200 cap; above-cap events log zero. Server append-only ledger; no reward for login or viewing.

nodes.label: Planned responses-submit Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Future transactional adapter inserts idempotent attempts then scores and updates mastery, Stardust and activity. Library tests do not prove adapter identity, clock, pause validation, durable deduplication or database integration.

nodes.label: Approved v0.1.0 clarifications
nodes.rationale: Normal confidence at Levels 3–5; strand-only placement with ordinary Stardust; proportional review compression; validated pause deadlines; first-highest milestones; cap-clamped awards; voluntary Rest Mode activity; fresh retention wait; repair based on actual activity.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Expression Preview Sheet

Its inline SVGs use an older palette (dusty-blue #D9E6F2 background, peach #F4DCD5 top, navy #1E2B38 glasses, no outlines) than the standalone SVG files, so the preview looks stale against the current Sweet Garden assets.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Round Avatar (Smiling)
nodes.rationale: Circle-cropped 240x240 bust of Auntie Stella smiling with open-mouth toothy grin, on mint #E1F2DB with confetti dots; intended as a round profile/avatar chip.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Listening
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square portrait; head tilted +4 degrees, open attentive eyes and a gentle closed-mouth smile, conveying attentive listening.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Proud
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square portrait; head lifted (translate -2, rotate -2), eyes closed in happy crescents and a broad closed smile, conveying pride in the user.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Smiling
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square default portrait: upright head, open eyes with catchlights, open-mouth grin showing teeth; the neutral-happy base expression.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Thinking
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square portrait; head tilted -4 degrees, one brow raised, pupils glancing up and right, flat slightly lopsided mouth, conveying pondering.

nodes.label: Stellara App Icon
